topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture and states what students should learn about cancer treatments.

topics.label: Surgery and radiotherapy for local cancer treatment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how localized tumors can be removed or irradiated, with chemotherapy supporting local treatment.

topics.label: Cytotoxic chemotherapy: mechanisms and limitations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how conventional cytotoxic drugs kill cells and why their effectiveness is constrained by toxicity and resistance.

topics.label: Targeting hormone-dependent cancers
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how blocking essential hormonal signals can suppress breast and prostate cancer growth.

topics.label: Exploiting cancer cell checkpoint defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how missing checkpoint proteins create opportunities to selectively attack cancer cells.

topics.label: PARP inhibition in BRCA-deficient cancers
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how inhibiting an alternative repair mechanism selectively kills cancer cells that lack functional BRCA proteins.

topics.label: Oncogene-directed treatment and kinase inhibition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics develop the principle of targeting a tumor's driving oncogenic event into the practical use of kinase inhibitors.

topics.label: Resistance and limitations of kinase inhibitor treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain why kinase inhibition often controls cancer chronically rather than curing it and how treatment must adapt to resistance.

topics.label: Antibody targeting of cancer cell surface proteins
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how antibodies recognizing cancer cell surface proteins can direct therapeutic effects toward those cells.

topics.label: Evidence for immune surveillance of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic evaluates whether the body's immune system naturally protects against cancer.

topics.label: Immune checkpoint blockade and tumor recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how checkpoint blockade restores antitumor T cell activity and why tumor neoantigens influence the response.

topics.label: Redirecting T cells toward cancer antigens
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine engineered approaches that direct T cell cytotoxicity toward antigen-bearing cancer cells.

topics.label: Treatment challenges and biomarker-guided therapy
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains why variable responses and evolving resistance require better ways to match patients to treatments.

topics.label: Cancer outcome trends, prevention and early detection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic assesses improvements in cancer outcomes while distinguishing treatment effects from prevention and earlier detection.

topics.label: Future treatment priorities and ethical dilemmas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics consider how future cancer treatments should be developed and evaluated when therapeutic benefit must be weighed against harm and established treatment success.
